summary: Master the art of financial strategy with our Balanced Scorecards training. Learn to align your goals and improve performance for sustainable growth.
lede: Balanced Scorecards in Financial Strategy helps you turn organizational vision into verifiable objectives across Financial, Customer, Internal Process, and Learning and Growth perspectives. You will learn to map cause-and-effect relationships, connect corporate goals with departmental action, and create a balanced view of performance. Build practical tools including strategy maps, KPI selection matrices, and executive dashboards while integrating risk management and Business Intelligence reporting. The course also introduces AI-assisted forecasting and automated data ingestion, giving you a structured roadmap for turning scattered performance data into a cohesive management system.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals responsible for the intersection of financial planning and organizational performance who need to prove the impact of strategic initiatives.
modules: Foundations of the Balanced Scorecard Framework
The Financial Perspective and Value Creation
Learning and Growth: The Intangible Assets
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of financial statements (Balance Sheet, P&L) and at least two years of experience in a management or analytical role. No prior experience with Balanced Scorecard software is required, but familiarity with Microsoft Excel for data modeling is highly recommended.
